release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.4

- Fixed Camera Toggle & Video Rendering: Turning camera off and on immediately streams and updates video feed to all participants.
- Fixed Duplicate Ending Notifications: Rapid double/triple taps on End Meeting send strictly one notification and prevent history clutter.
- Fixed Scheduled Call Time: Preserved authentic meeting time (resolved 4:46 PM overwrite bug).
- Direct Update Download: Any older version directly upgrades to the newest release without downloading intermediate versions one-by-one.
- Automatic 14-Day Purge & Meeting Priority: Upcoming calls always appear first; calls older than 2 weeks are automatically removed.
- General stability, audio clarity, and performance improvements across live prayer meetings.
